value.text: In episode 5, Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian land on Earth, where zombies turn them into the undead before Hope's ants devour them.

verdicts.why: Both are zombified and then killed by Hope van Dyne's ants in that episode (Maw stripped to bones, Obsidian reduced to dust), so Deceased is right; 'strip them to the bone' only fits Maw, so the wording is adjusted.
Eldrac is a living wall in Attilan who teleports the evacuees to Earth and is crushed as the city falls; he is never in Hawaii.
Auran helps Karnak revive Gorgon in the palace Terrigen chambers, refuses to kill Medusa and leaves Maximus in Attilan (episodes 7-8) before evacuating to Earth, so Attilan belongs alongside Hawaii.
Gorgon dies at Declan's facility on Oahu, but is revived in a Terrigenesis chamber in Attilan, where he kills Declan and is locked in the Quiet Room.
Karnak's second Terrigenesis of Gorgon and his escape from the Quiet Room both happen in Attilan (episodes 7-8).
Wikipedia's plot opens 'In Prague, Blade searches for his mentor Abraham Whistler... Blade rescues Whistler and cures him'; Prague (Earth-26320) is an existing place.

The record covers the two-part pilot (episodes 1-2), while the Conclave Massacre (Marcus's virus killing the purebloods, Krista exposed as Blade's spy) is the episode 13 'Conclave' event, so the case does not match this record.
Wikipedia: 'The media dubs them The Fantastic Four'; Johnny is the one who names them Human Torch, Invisible Woman, Mr. Fantastic and the Thing.

value.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
value.text: Freed by the Four, the Surfer takes back his board, revives Sue and flies into Galactus, vanishing in a massive blast. Later, his lifeless body drifts through space until his eyes open and his board returns to him.

verdicts.why: The missing record is supported by the plot (Four free him from the Siberia cell, he regains his board and revives Sue in Shanghai, confronts Galactus, then revives in space), but its places should not be empty.
Episode 8: Auran refuses Maximus's order to kill Medusa, leaves him when he will let the city die, and joins the evacuation ('Disillusioned, Auran deserts Maximus and joins the evacuation').
Episode 4: the explosion at Declan's facility knocks Locus out and Black Bolt and Medusa take her with them to find their family, so she ends the episode their captive, not at large.
Declan is handed to Maximus in Attilan and the revived Gorgon kills him in the Terrigenesis chambers there.
Episode 8 'Ghost Stories': Tyrone haunts Connors as Billy's ghost, Connors confesses to the murder and O'Reilly arrests him; episode 9 has him arrested and suspended.

The sources do not show the hedge maze is wrong: the Marvel Database film summary places the kill in the maze yard outside the house, where Kirigi is stabbed with a sai and falls into a well, so the change is not clearly supported.
